title: Frog in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- frog body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='28' ry='22' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- belly lighter shade -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#A5D6A7'/>
  <!-- left eye bump -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='42' r='12' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- right eye bump -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='42' r='12' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- left eye white -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='40' r='8' fill='#E8F5E9'/>
  <!-- right eye white -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='40' r='8' fill='#E8F5E9'/>
  <!-- left pupil -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='40' r='4' fill='#1B5E20'/>
  <!-- right pupil -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='40' r='4' fill='#1B5E20'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 56 Q50 66 62 56' stroke='#1B5E20' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='54' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FF8A80' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- right cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='54' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FF8A80' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- scarf around neck -->
  <path d='M28 58 Q50 66 72 58 L74 64 Q50 72 26 64 Z' fill='#E53935'/>
  <!-- scarf stripe -->
  <path d='M29 60 Q50 68 71 60 L72 62 Q50 70 28 62 Z' fill='#FFCDD2'/>
  <!-- scarf hanging end -->
  <path d='M64 64 Q70 76 66 86 L60 84 Q63 74 58 64 Z' fill='#E53935'/>
  <!-- scarf end stripe -->
  <path d='M63 70 Q68 74 66 82 L62 80 Q64 74 61 70 Z' fill='#FFCDD2'/>
  <!-- scarf fringe -->
  <line x1='60' y1='84' x2='60' y2='88' stroke='#FFCDD2' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='63' y1='85' x2='63' y2='89' stroke='#FFCDD2' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='66' y1='84' x2='66' y2='88' stroke='#FFCDD2' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left front foot -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='88' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='87' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='86' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='87' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- right front foot -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='88' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='87' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='86' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='87' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
</svg>
